comment: Copy to config/civ6ai.local.json (gitignored). reasoning is on|off for LM Studio only — never send reasoning_effort=on to LM Studio. reasoning_effort is off|low|medium|high|xhigh and is what OpenRouter receives (off disables reasoning). Per seat: seat_models {"0": {"model": "provider/model", "reasoning_effort": "high", "max_prompt_chars": 240000}} and/or env CIV6AI_MODEL_PLAYER_<n>, CIV6AI_REASONING_EFFORT, CIV6AI_REASONING_EFFORT_PLAYER_<n>, CIV6AI_MAX_PROMPT_CHARS_PLAYER_<n>. Env model/effort/prompt size overrides seat_models. max_prompt_chars is the text prompt target (about 60000 tokens at 4 chars/token). 0 disables that size ladder. The map image stays attached. MEMORY is reserved for the Civ V turn-importance port and is trimmable. Each seat-turn appends latency_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, reasoning_tokens, cost, prompt_section_chars, and prompt_compactions to turn_metrics.jsonl. Other env: CIV6AI_MODEL_PROVIDER, LMSTUDIO_BASE_URL, LMSTUDIO_MODEL, LMSTUDIO_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_MODEL, CIV6AI_LMSTUDIO_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, CIV6AI_LMSTUDIO_VISION, CIV6AI_LMSTUDIO_REASONING, CIV6AI_CONTEXT_BUDGET, CIV6AI_MAX_PROMPT_CHARS, CIV6AI_QUEUE_SHARED_MODEL.
